E2 shows precipitation strengthening in a different alloy (Al0.7CoCrFeNi) but does not demonstrate SRO or nano-cluster formation in CoCrFeNiTi. E3 discusses SRO effects in MPEAs generally but provides no data on CoCrFeNiTi or the specific heat treatment. Thus, the key premises lack specific prior evidence or are contradicted.
premises: Equimolar CoCrFeNiTi in the as-cast state lacks SRO or coherent nano-clusters.
SRO or nano-clusters act as effective obstacles to dislocation motion, increasing strength.
A 550 °C/24 h heat treatment can induce SRO or nano-clusters in CoCrFeNiTi without precipitation.
Inducing SRO/nano-clusters will measurably increase hardness and yield strength while reducing ductility.
